content: The archived Stage 2 round 6 fixed-ROI LK procedure lost left-finger tracks across grasp/lift. Its 1 px fixture-motion gate was a method-specific assumption, not a necessary condition for RGB calibration. Common 2D translation cancels in relative finger motion; perspective, rotation and feature identity remain unresolved. The original run used the wrong camera clock; source corrected later without rerunning the measurement.
applicability: This installation, right wrist 640x480 RGB, three 20261109 failed episodes, frozen ROIs in Stage 2 round 6
embodiment: This Piper installation; no six-axis force sensor, no real depth
count_semantics: measurement eligibility per episode, not task success or statistically independent generalization trials
limitations: Full-window feature-survival criterion; no semantic tracker
Background movement does not identify its physical cause
No calibrated metric aperture, real depth or contact force
No policy or physical calibration promotion
Original six-round results remain historical; phase boundaries not re-evaluated after clock correction
No fitting was run after the gate failed: this is not an experimentally failed contact-parameter repair
Existing multiaxis RGB captures were omitted by that narrow audit; inspect calibration archives before claiming data unavailable
